description.value: Donair Addict is Tofino's evening shawarma counter, serving substantial beef and chicken wraps built from top sirloin and free-range marinated chicken — a cut above the typical fast-food donair. The falafel option and gluten-free rice base make it a viable stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions. It bills itself as the high-quality shawarma option in an oceanside surf town not otherwise known for Middle Eastern food.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides a full menu, phone number (778-837-0707), and a confirmed street address (220 Campbell Street, Tofino). The menu explicitly labels Falafel as '100% vegetarian' and notes a Gluten Free rice option for all items, confirming vegetarian/GF. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM has no phone number recorded; 778-837-0707 sourced from website only.
OSM address lacks house number; website contact page confirms '220 Campbell Street, Tofino'.
OSM cuisine tag is 'donair' but the business self-describes as a 'shawarma joint' — minor mismatch, not a concern for directory inclusion.
Website contact page states 'Online or Phone orders not available right now' while the menu page instructs customers to call to order — minor internal inconsistency on site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food business in Tofino with a live website, phone number, and full menu. A legitimate evening food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Falafel as '100% vegetarian dish'; all menu items offer a rice base described as 'Gluten Free'

wow_evidence: Tofino's evening shawarma counter... the high-quality shawarma option in an oceanside surf town
